title: The Nazirite Vow

questions.question: Who could take a Nazirite vow?
options: Either a man or a woman
questions.correctAnswer: Either a man or a woman
questions.explanation: Numbers 6:2 (ESV): "When either a man or a woman makes a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite..."

questions.question: What was the Nazirite forbidden to consume?
options: Wine, strong drink, or anything from the grapevine
questions.correctAnswer: Wine, strong drink, or anything from the grapevine
questions.explanation: Numbers 6:3-4 (ESV): "He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink... nothing that is produced by the grapevine..."

questions.question: What rule applied to the Nazirite's hair?
options: No razor shall touch his head
questions.correctAnswer: No razor shall touch his head
questions.explanation: Numbers 6:5 (ESV): "All the days of his vow... no razor shall touch his head."

questions.question: What was the restriction regarding dead bodies?
options: He shall not go near a dead body
questions.correctAnswer: He shall not go near a dead body
questions.explanation: Numbers 6:6 (ESV): "He shall not go near a dead body."

questions.question: How does the priestly blessing begin?
options: The Lord bless you and keep you
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord bless you and keep you
questions.explanation: Numbers 6:24 (ESV): "The Lord bless you and keep you..."

questions.question: If a Nazirite suddenly becomes unclean by a sudden death nearby, what happens?
options: He forfeits the previous days and starts over
questions.correctAnswer: He forfeits the previous days and starts over
questions.explanation: Numbers 6:12 (ESV): "And the previous period shall be void, because his separation was defiled."

questions.question: What offering is made when recommencing the vow after defilement?
options: Two turtles doves and a male lamb
questions.correctAnswer: Two turtles doves and a male lamb
questions.explanation: Numbers 6:10, 12: Two birds for sin/burnt offering, and a lamb for a guilt offering.

questions.question: What happens to the hair when the vow is completed?
options: It is shaved and put on the fire under the peace offering
questions.correctAnswer: It is shaved and put on the fire under the peace offering
questions.explanation: Numbers 6:18 (ESV): "And put it on the fire that is under the sacrifice of the peace offering."

questions.question: What offerings are brought at the completion of the vow?
options: Male lamb, ewe lamb, ram, basket of unleavened bread
questions.correctAnswer: Male lamb, ewe lamb, ram, basket of unleavened bread
questions.explanation: Numbers 6:14 (ESV): "One male lamb... one ewe lamb... one ram... basket of unleavened bread..."

questions.question: What does "Nazirite" mean?
questions.explanation: From the Hebrew root "nazar", meaning to separate. Context (v2): "to separate himself to the Lord."

questions.question: "The Lord make his face to...?"
questions.explanation: Numbers 6:25 (ESV): "The Lord make his face to shine upon you and be gracious to you."

questions.question: Even if his father or mother dies, can a Nazirite make himself unclean?
questions.explanation: Numbers 6:7 (ESV): "Not make himself unclean... for his father or for his mother... because his separation to God is on his head."

questions.question: The priest waves which parts as a wave offering at the end?
options: The shoulder of the ram and bread
questions.correctAnswer: The shoulder of the ram and bread
questions.explanation: Numbers 6:19-20 (ESV): "The shoulder of the ram... and one unleavened cake... priest shall wave them..."

questions.question: Can a Nazirite drink wine after the vow is complete?
questions.explanation: Numbers 6:20 (ESV): "And after that the Nazirite may drink wine."

questions.question: What is the purpose of placing God's name on the people?
questions.explanation: Numbers 6:27 (ESV): "So shall they put my name upon the people of Israel, and I will bless them."

key_verse_text: The Lord bless you and keep you; the Lord make his face to shine upon you and be gracious to you; the Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace.
